about: flagship/llm-promo-issue/v1 (docs/build-modes.md, free AI credits). Canonical: tag|username|serverFqdn|provider|desiredDailyInputTokenCap|desiredDailyOutputTokenCap|issuedAt. Free AI clients always send provider "flagship" and both caps 0; serverFqdn is the box the build runs on, or empty for a status read. These cases sign with the protocol IRK derived from umkSeedHex (deriveIRK / deriveProtocolIrkSeed) only to pin the bytes; a real request is signed with the key .com holds for the account, the same one each app signs push registration with.
